abuse_act_body: We can suspend an engine: our relays stop routing its address, and it can no longer register or report in. We cannot delete anything from the owner's server. For an engine on a custom domain, also tell the domain's owner or registrar.
abuse_contact_unavailable: The address could not be loaded. Try again later.
abuse_intro: Promptbook engines run on their owners' own servers. Each one is reachable at an address under our engine domain or at a custom domain. If one of them hosts phishing, malware or anything else that harms people, tell us.
abuse_report_item_address: the full address (URL) of the page, including the engine's hostname;
abuse_report_item_evidence: a screenshot, or the message that led you there, if you have one.
abuse_report_item_what: what the page does or asks for, and when you saw it;
abuse_report_response: We confirm every report and act on a confirmed one within hours. Do not send us passwords or other secrets you may have typed into the page.
abuse_security: Security vulnerabilities in Promptbook itself go to the same address. Machine-readable details are in
abuse_see_can: We can see which account an engine belongs to, whether it is online, how much traffic passes through our relays, and the page it shows to anyone who opens it without signing in. We check that public page ourselves, as any visitor would.
abuse_see_cannot: We cannot see what an engine shows to signed-in users or what its traffic contains: the connection is encrypted end to end between the visitor's browser and the owner's server, and our relays only pass it on.
abuse_see_title: What we can and cannot see
account_email_body: Sign-up and recovery links go to this address.
admin_billing_body: Organizations whose payment is overdue, unpaid or whose subscription ended. Nothing is suspended automatically: decide case by case.
admin_billing_empty_body: No organization has an overdue, unpaid or ended subscription.
admin_billing_load_failed: The list could not be loaded.
admin_billing_summary: Organizations with overdue, unpaid or ended subscriptions.
admin_engine_load_failed: The engine could not be loaded.
admin_engine_reason_hint: The report or ticket and what you confirmed. Kept in the audit log; never paste content from the page.
admin_engine_revoked_body: Its owner revoked this engine. A revocation is permanent and cannot be lifted here; the owner links a new engine instead.
admin_engine_suspend_body: Relays close the engine's tunnel within five minutes and refuse new ones; registration and heartbeats are refused, and its custom domains stop routing. The owner sees that Promptbook suspended it, not your reason.
admin_engine_unsuspend_body: Relays route the engine again at their next registry refresh, within five minutes, and it can register and send heartbeats again.
admin_engines_summary: Open any engine by its ID to suspend it or set up its custom domains.
admin_hostnames_add_claim_hint: Base64url. The engine prints it when it runs with PTBK_CUSTOM_DOMAIN set to this hostname.
admin_hostnames_add_hostname_hint: For example agents.customer.com. Unicode names are stored as A-labels.
admin_hostnames_added: Domain added. Check DNS once the customer's CNAME is in place.
admin_hostnames_checked_error: The DNS lookup failed. Try again in a moment.
admin_hostnames_checked_pending: The CNAME of {hostname} does not point at the engine yet.
admin_hostnames_claim_invalid: Enter the 86-character signature the engine printed.
admin_hostnames_empty_body: Add the customer's hostname with the claim their engine produced.
admin_hostnames_error_bad_claim: The claim does not verify: the engine's key must sign exactly this hostname and engine ID.
admin_hostnames_error_invalid_hostname: This is not a hostname relays can route: no IP addresses, wildcards or names over 253 characters.
admin_hostnames_error_limit: This engine already has the most custom domains it can have.
admin_hostnames_error_reserved: This name is under a domain the platform reserves.
admin_hostnames_error_taken: This hostname is already attached to an engine.
admin_hostnames_intro: Only active domains reach relays, and relays check the engine's claim and the CNAME again on their own.
admin_hostnames_load_failed: The domains could not be loaded.
admin_hostnames_lookup_hint: 26 characters, the first label of the engine's address.
admin_hostnames_remove_body: {hostname} stops routing to this engine within 5 minutes, when relays refresh their registry.
admin_hostnames_summary: Attach an Enterprise customer's hostname to one engine.
admin_hostnames_target_body: The customer adds a CNAME record from their hostname to this name, never to a relay. Apex domains cannot have a CNAME and are not supported.
api_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
api_error_unreachable: Promptbook could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
billing_already_subscribed: This organization already has a subscription. Manage it through Manage billing.
billing_checkout_cancel: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
billing_checkout_success_body: It can take a moment until the new plan shows here.
billing_checkout_success_title: Thank you, your subscription is starting
billing_none_not_allowed: This organization has no plan yet. An owner can choose one here.
billing_none_title: Choose a plan to link engines
billing_payment_problem_body: Update your payment method in Manage billing. Your engines keep working in the meantime.
billing_plans_body: Payment happens on Stripe; card details never reach Promptbook.
billing_price_at_checkout: Price shown on Stripe before you pay
billing_redirect_refused: Billing sent an unexpected address, so the page stayed here. Try again later.
billing_trial_note: Stripe asks for your card, and nothing is charged until the trial ends.
billing_unknown_plan: That plan is no longer offered. The list was refreshed.
cooldown_body: Until {until}, nobody can remove engines, change custom hostnames or change billing ownership on this account. If you did not recover it, remove the passkey added through recovery and secure your email.
dev_mailbox_empty_body: Sign up or ask for a recovery link, and the email shows up here.
dev_mailbox_load_failed: The outbox could not be loaded.
dev_mailbox_summary: Every email the fake email adapter recorded since the dashboard started, newest first. Links to this dashboard open here.
email_access_waiting_body:
Hi,

{requester} opened the team {team} and is waiting for access to its engine.

To let them in, open the engine and go to Members → Access requests. Ask {requester} for the code on their screen and type it in.

The team in the dashboard:

{link}

If you don't recognise this request, decline it there.
email_account_exists_subject: You already have a Promptbook account
email_invalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
email_recovery_link_body:
Hi,

To recover access to your Promptbook account, open this link and register a new passkey. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes:

{link}

After recovery, every other session is signed out, and for 72 hours nobody can remove engines or change billing ownership on this account.

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Nothing changes.
email_recovery_link_subject: Recover access to your Promptbook account
email_recovery_notice_body:
Hi,

Access to your Promptbook account was recovered on {recoveredAt}, and a new passkey was registered. Every other session was signed out.

Until {cooldownEndsAt}, nobody can remove engines or change billing ownership on this account.

If this was not you, sign in with one of your passkeys at {signInLink}, remove the passkey added by recovery under Account, and secure your email account. The dashboard has no access to your engines' data.
email_sent_hint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
email_sent_recovery: If {email} belongs to a Promptbook account, we sent it a recovery link. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
email_sent_signup: We sent a link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
email_signup_link_body:
Hi,

To finish creating your Promptbook account, open this link and create a passkey. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes:

{link}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. No account is created.
email_team_invite_body:
Hi,

{inviter} invited you to {org} on Promptbook.

Teams: {teams}

Accept the invitation here. You can sign in or create an account with this email address:

{link}

The link works until {expiresAt}. After you accept, open a team and someone already on its engine approves your access.

If you didn't expect this, ignore this email.
engine_error: The engine could not be loaded.
engine_fingerprint_body: The engine's own security page shows the same pattern and code. Compare them before you trust the address: if they differ, you are not on this engine.
engine_heartbeat_body: Exactly what the engine last reported to Promptbook: numbers and fixed values only, never anything from inside the engine.
engine_heartbeat_none: No heartbeat has been received yet, or it was older than 30 days and deleted.
engine_name_hint: Shown here and in status emails. Leave it empty to use the engine ID.
engine_name_invalid: Use up to 40 letters, digits, spaces and . , _ ' ( ) # + - –
engine_not_found_body: This engine does not exist in this organization.
engine_not_found_other_org: Check the link. If the engine belongs to another of your organizations, switch to it at the top of the page.
engine_offline_hint: If its server is up, run this on it:
engine_revoke_body: Revoke this engine if its key may be compromised. Revocation is permanent for this engine ID.
engine_revoke_dialog_address: Its address stops working, and so do bookmarks and the engine's passkeys for it.
engine_revoke_dialog_body: Promptbook stops routing this engine within minutes. This cannot be undone.
engine_revoke_dialog_recover: To use the server again, reset the engine's identity and owner on it, then link it with a new code. It gets a new ID and address.
engine_revoked_body: You revoked this engine. Our relays no longer route its address, and this engine identity cannot be linked again.
engine_status_unknown_body: The engine's status could not be read just now. It refreshes on its own.
engine_suspended_body: Promptbook suspended this engine, so our relays no longer route its address.
engine_suspended_contact: To learn why or to appeal, write to

engines_error: The engines could not be loaded.
engines_new_checkout_pending: Thank you. Your plan is starting; this takes a moment.
engines_new_command_body: Copy it now: it is shown only once and expires in {time}.
engines_new_compose_hint: Put the Compose file from the guide on the host, then run these in its directory.
engines_new_eligibility_failed: Whether this organization can link an engine could not be loaded.
engines_new_engine_limit_body: Upgrade your plan or remove an engine to link another one.
engines_new_engine_limit_title: Your plan's engine limit is reached
engines_new_expired_body: Create a new one to link your engine.
engines_new_intro: Run this on the server that will host Promptbook.
engines_new_move: Moving from an existing Promptbook server? Install the new engine next to it, then import your agents. Your old server keeps running until you switch.
engines_new_not_allowed: Only owners of this organization can link engines.
engines_new_not_entitled_body: Subscribe to a plan to link an engine.
engines_new_not_entitled_title: Your plan does not include engines
engines_new_plan_body: Engines need a plan with a card on file. Payment happens on Stripe; card details never reach Promptbook.
engines_new_plan_title: Choose a plan to link your engine
engines_new_requirements: It needs outbound HTTPS (port 443) and nothing inbound.
engines_new_subscription_started: Thank you, your subscription has started.
engines_new_trial_started: Thank you, your trial has started.
engines_not_allowed: Your role in this organization cannot see its engines.

error_forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
error_mutation_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

error_recovery_cooldown_generic: Blocked for 72 hours after your account was recovered.
error_step_up_cancelled: Not done: this action needs a fresh check with your passkey.
invite_body: They get an email with a link. Once they accept, they open a team and someone on its engine approves them.
invite_emails_hint: Up to {max} addresses, separated by commas or new lines.
invite_emails_invalid: Enter one or more email addresses.
invite_page_body_unnamed: You're invited to an organization on Promptbook.

invite_page_mismatch: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
invite_page_sign_in_first: Sign in as {email} to accept. New to Promptbook? Create an account with that address, then open the invitation link again.
invite_role_hint: Admins manage teams and people. Members use the teams they're in.
link_expired_body: Links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.
link_progress_compare: Your terminal shows the same fingerprint. Compare them: if they differ, this is not your engine.
link_progress_load_failed: The link progress could not be loaded.
link_progress_name: Give it a name so you can tell your engines apart. You can change it later.
link_progress_no_heartbeat_hint: Linked, but no heartbeat yet. The engine may still be downloading or starting. If the terminal shows an error, it says what to do.
link_progress_online_waiting: Waiting for the engine's first heartbeat.
link_progress_owner: Open the setup link your terminal shows to finish. This page updates when you're done.

link_progress_unknown_title: This link code is not known here

link_progress_waiting_hint: Nothing yet? The engine reports problems in the terminal. Common causes:
link_progress_waiting_resumed: Waiting for your engine to link. This page updates by itself.
not_found_body: This page does not exist, or it moved.
passkey_error_already_registered: This device already holds a passkey for your account. Use another device, a phone or a security key.
passkey_error_cancelled_authenticate: The passkey prompt was closed, timed out, or found no Promptbook passkey on this device. Try again, use a passkey on your phone or a security key, or recover access.
passkey_error_cancelled_register: The passkey prompt was closed or timed out. Try again when you are ready.
passkey_error_failed: The passkey did not work. Try again.
passkey_error_no_authenticator: No passkey can be created on this device: it needs a screen lock, PIN or a security key. Try another device or a security key.
passkey_error_not_allowed: This page is not allowed to use passkeys here. Open the dashboard at its usual address over a secure connection.
passkey_error_not_verified_authenticate: That passkey is not registered with Promptbook, or it could not be verified. Try another passkey.
passkey_error_not_verified_register: The new passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use another device.
passkey_error_title: The passkey step did not finish
passkey_error_token_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
passkey_error_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use an up-to-date browser.
passkey_remove_body: {name} will no longer sign in to this account. Sessions it started stay signed in until you sign out everywhere.
passkey_remove_last: Your only passkey cannot be removed. Add another one first.
passkey_what_is: A passkey stays on your device or in your password manager. It cannot be phished, and we never see it.
passkeys_body: Each passkey can sign in to this account. Keep at least two, on different devices.
passkeys_load_failed: Your passkeys could not be loaded.
people_last_owner: The organization needs at least one owner.
people_not_allowed: Only owners and admins see the organization's people.
people_remove_body: They leave every team. Each team's engine removes them within a minute or two, unless its owner turned that off.
recover_body: Lost every passkey? Enter your account email and we send you a link to register a new one.
recover_passkey_body: This link lets you add one new passkey to your account.
recover_passkey_consequences: Afterwards, every other session is signed out, and removing engines or changing billing ownership is blocked for 72 hours.
recovered_body: Your new passkey is registered and you are signed in. Every other session was signed out, and we emailed you a notice.
recovered_next: Review your passkeys and remove any you no longer have.
sessions_body: Browsers signed in to this account. Signing out everywhere includes this browser.
sessions_load_failed: Your sessions could not be loaded.
sessions_revoke_all_body: Every browser signed in to this account is signed out, this one too. You sign in again with a passkey.
sign_out_failed: Signing out did not work. Try again.
signin_body: Use the passkey you created for Promptbook. There is no password.
signup_body: Enter your email. We send you a link to create a passkey; there is no password.
signup_passkey_body: Your passkey is how you sign in to the Promptbook dashboard. Your device asks you to confirm with your fingerprint, face, PIN or security key.
signup_value: Run AI agents on your own server and use them from anywhere. Your data stays with you.
step_up_body: This action needs a fresh check with your passkey.
team_access_note: Access to a team's engine is approved on the engine itself. These states are what the engine has told the dashboard.
team_delete_body: Its engine is unlinked: the relay stops reaching it and it disappears from here. The engine keeps running on its machine with its data.
team_delete_body_no_engine: The team and its list of people go away.
team_error: This team could not be loaded.
team_member_remove_body: Their access to the team's engine is taken away within a minute or two, unless its owner turned that off.
team_name_hint: Usually the client or department it works for.
team_name_invalid: Use letters, digits, spaces and simple punctuation, up to 64 characters.
team_no_engine_body: This team has no engine yet.
team_not_found_body: It may have been deleted, or you're not in it.
team_open_unavailable: Opening teams isn't available right now. Try again later.
team_refused_disabled: This engine doesn't accept removals from here; remove them on the engine.
team_refused_owner: Transfer ownership on the engine first.
teams_empty_body: A team is a group of people with its own engine. Create one for each client or department.
teams_empty_member_body: Ask an owner or admin of this organization to add you to a team.
teams_empty_member_title: You're not in a team yet
trust_account_body: You sign in with a passkey, so there is no password to steal or reuse. Payment happens on Stripe; card details never reach Promptbook.
trust_app_body: The app you use on your engine is a signed, publicly logged release. Your engine downloads it, checks the signature and serves it itself, so nothing we host runs code on your engine's address.
trust_data_body: Your agents, chats, files and everything your agents produce live on your engine. This dashboard keeps your account, your organization, your engines' addresses and status, and billing. It never stores engine content, not even encrypted.
trust_data_title: Your data stays on your server
trust_intro: Promptbook runs your AI agents on your own server. We provide the connection, this dashboard and the app you use, and we built all three so that we cannot read what your engine holds.
trust_link_body: The install command carries a link code. It ties the engine to your organization for routing and billing, works once and expires after at most 30 minutes. It grants nothing inside the engine: no access to its agents, chats or files.
trust_owner_body: Only the engine can make you its owner. When it first starts, its terminal shows a setup link and a QR code. Open it and create a passkey for the engine itself, separate from the one you use here. We never see that link, which is why this dashboard cannot show it to you.
trust_relay_body: Browsers reach your engine through our relays. The connection is encrypted end to end between the browser and your server: the relays only pass it on, never decrypt it, and hold none of your engine's keys or certificates.
